Group Resource Get Group
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/groups/:groupId

Retrieves the group based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
groupId
int32
REQUIRED

Group ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the group

name
string
REQUIRED

Group name

idpId
int64

Unique identifier for the identity provider (IdP)

comments
string

Additional information about the group

isSystemDefined
boolean

System-defined group
